name: service_tow
prompt:
Image 1 is a finished sprite sheet of nine tow trucks for a 2D top-down city game, seen straight down from above, each with its nose to the right. Only the transparent areas of the mask are redrawn: the places of truck 2 (top row, middle) and truck 4 (middle row, left). Redraw each of those two trucks in its place, matching the other seven trucks of image 1 exactly in art style, outline weight, shading, livery and detail:

- An orange-yellow cab at the front, then an open dark grey steel tow deck behind it with a low dark rail each side, and across the very tail a bar in red and white diagonal hazard stripes with a tail lamp at each rear corner — as the other trucks of image 1 have.
- EACH CAB HAS A LONG FLAT ROOF: behind the windscreen, a plain yellow cab roof about as long as truck 3's (top row, right) before the deck begins — never the windscreen running straight into the deck.
- SLIMMER: truck 2 and truck 4 are each exactly as wide as truck 3 beside them, and as long as the space they had in image 1. In the last drawing both came out about 10 % too wide.
- Truck 2 is a 2000s Japanese off-road 4×4: a flat square bonnet, square front corners. Truck 4 is a 1990s van: a short sloping bonnet.
- Nothing on the cab roof but paint. No crane, boom or arm. The glass dark, every lamp switched off, no text, letters, numbers or logos.

Background: fully transparent outside the trucks — no colour, no glow or halo, no shadow. Everything outside the masked areas stays as it is.
